requirements.description: Daily prices for continuous futures calc series (settlement, OHLC, volume, open interest) used to compound daily excess returns into instrument return indexes. This requirement also backs the in-sample equal-weighted passive asset-class proxies that replace MSCI World / Barclays Aggregate / S&P GSCI (those external index series are not in ClickHouse; the paper's own futures within each asset class stand in, per the Table 2/Table 3 notes).

Continuous-series metadata for mapping the paper's 58 instruments (Appendix A) to Datastream calc series: exchange-prefixed series name, roll method (volume-based / first-of-month roll implements the paper's 'most liquid, nearest or next-nearest contract'), and front-contract position flag.
Contract-level metadata (contract names, listing start dates, currency units) used to verify instrument start dates against Table 1 column 1 and to pick the correct exchange contract per Appendix A.

Fama-French factors for the alpha regressions (Eq. 4, Table 2, Table 3, Table 5 Panel C): SMB, HML, UMD (momentum, column 'mom') and the risk-free rate. The rf column also supplies the T-bill rate for excess returns.

CFTC Commitments of Traders positions (speculator long vs short by reporter type, open interest) for the Net speculator position variable. Available in ClickHouse via Datastream's COT table; NOT exercised by the currently selected targets (Table 1 speculator columns and Table 6 are deferred to a future iteration — see T1 notes).
